Maal-o-Daulat aur A'maal: Irshad hota hai ke duniya ki mohabbat aur uske paalne ki koshish ne tumhein Aakhirat ki talab aur nek kaamon se be-parwah kar diya. Tum isi duniya ki udher-bun mein rahe ke achanak maut aa gayi aur tum qabron mein pahunch gaye. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain, ita'at-e-Parwardigar se tum ne duniya ki justuju mein phans kar be-raghbati kar li aur marte dam tak ghaflat barti (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain, maal aur aulad ki ziyadati ki hawas mein maut ka khayal pare phenk diya. Sahih Bukhari Kitab-ur-Riqaq mein hai ke Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain, hum "Law kana li-ibni Adama wadiyan min dhahab" yani agar Ibn-e-Adam ke paas ek jangal bhar kar sona ho, ise Quran ki aayat hi samajhte rahe yahan tak ke "Alhakumut-Takathur" nazil hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Shikh-kheer (R.A) farmate hain, main janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein jab aaya to aap is aayat ko parh rahe the. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, Ibn-e-Adam kehta rehta hai ke mera maal, mera maal, halankeh tera maal sirf woh hai jise tu ne kha kar fana kar diya, ya pehan kar phaar diya, ya sadqa de kar baqi rakh liya. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein itna aur ziyada hai ke iske siwa jo kuch hai, ise to tu logon ke liye chor-chaar kar chal dega. Bukhari ki hadith mein hai, mayyat ke saath teen cheezein jaati hain, jin mein se do to palat aati hain, sirf ek saath reh jaati hai; ghar wale, maal aur a'maal. Ahl-o-maal laut aaye, amal saath reh gaye. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai, Ibn-e-Adam boorha ho jaata hai lekin do cheezein uske saath baqi reh jaati hain; lalach aur umang. Hazrat Sahhak ne ek shakhs ke haath mein ek dirham dekh kar poocha, yeh dirham kis ka hai? Usne kaha mera. Farmaya, tera to us waqt hoga ke kisi nek kaam mein tu kharch kar de ya bator-e-shukr-e-Rabb ke kharch kare. Hazrat Ahnaf ne is waqiye ko bayan kar ke phir yeh sher parha: "Anta lil-maali iza amsaktahu, fa-iza anfaqtahu fal-maalu laka" yani jab tak tu maal ko liye baitha hai, to tu maal ki milkiyat hai, haan jab ise kharch kar dega us waqt maal teri milkiyat mein ho jayega. Ibn-e-Buraidah farmate hain, Banu Haritha aur Banu Harith Ansar ke qabile wale apne mein se aison ko pesh karte the. Jab zindon ke saath yeh fakhr-o-mubahat kar chuke to kehne lage, aao qabristan mein chalein, wahan ja kar apne apne murdon ki qabron ki taraf ishare kar ke kehne lage, batao is jaisa bhi tum mein koi guzra hai? Woh unhein apne murdon ke saath ilzam dene lage. Is par yeh dono ibtidai aayatein utrin ke tum fakhr-o-mubahat karte hue qabristan mein pahunch gaye aur apne apne murdon par bhi fakhr-o-ghuroor karne lage. Chahiye tha ke yahan aa kar ibrat hasil karte, apna marna aur sarna-galna yaad karte.

Hazrat Qatada Rahimahullah farmate hain ke log apni ziyadati aur apni kasrat par ghamand karte thay yahan tak ke ek ek ho kar qabron mein pahunch gaye. Matlab yeh hai ke bohtat ki chahat ne ghaflat mein hi rakha yahan tak ke mar gaye aur qabron mein dafan ho gaye. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek a'arabi ki bimar pursi ko gaye aur hasb-e-adat farmaya koi dar khauf nahin, Insha'Allah gunahon se pakeezgi hasil hogi. To usne kaha aap ise khoob paka batla rahe hain, yeh to woh bukhar hai jo boodhe badon par josh marta hai aur qabr tak pahuncha kar rehta hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya achha phir yun hi sahi. Is hadith mein bhi lafz 'tazoorul quboor' hai aur yahan Quran mein bhi 'zurtumul maqabir' hai. Pas maloom hota hai ke is se murad mar kar qabr mein dafan hona hi hai. Tirmidhi mein hai Hazrat Ali Karamallahu Wajhahu farmate hain ke jab tak yeh ayat na utri hum azab-e-qabr ke bare mein shak mein hi rahe. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz ne is ayat ki tilawat ki phir kuch der soch kar farmane lage, Maimoon! Qabron ka dekhna to sirf bator-e-ziyarat hai aur har ziyarat karne wala apni jagah laut jata hai, yani khwah jannat ki taraf khwah dozakh ki taraf. Ek a'arabi ne bhi ek shakhs ki zabani in dono ayaton ki tilawat sun kar yahi farmaya tha ke asal maqam aur hi hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala dhamkate hue do do martaba farmata hai ke haqiqat-e-hal ka ilm tumhein abhi ho jayega. Yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke pehle murad kuffar hain, dobara momin murad hain. Phir farmata hai ke agar tum ilm-e-yaqini ke sath ise maloom kar lete, yani agar aisa hota to tum ghaflat mein na padte aur marte dam tak apni akhri manzil-e-akhirat se ghafil na rehte. Phir jis cheez se pehle dhamkaya tha usi ka bayan kar raha hai ke tum jahannam ko inhi ankhon se dekh loge ke uski ek hi junbish ke sath aur to aur Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) bhi haibat-o-khauf ke mare ghutnon ke bal gir jayenge. Uski azmat aur dehshat har dil par chhayi hui hogi jaise ke bahut si ahadith mein ba-tafseel marwi hai. Phir farmaya ke us din tum se nematon ki bazpurs hogi, sehat, amn, rizq wagaira tamam nematon ki nisbat sawal hoga ke in ka shukr kahan tak ada kiya. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek ghareeb hadith mein hai ke theek dopahar ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne ghar se chale dekha to Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) bhi masjid mein aa rahe hain. Poocha ke is waqt kaise nikle ho? Kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jis cheez ne aap ko nikala hai usi ne mujhe bhi nikala hai. Itne mein Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) bhi aa gaye, un se bhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yahi sawal kiya aur aap ne bhi yahi jawab diya. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne in dono buzurgon se baten karni shuru keen phir farmaya ke agar himmat ho to is bagh tak chale chalo, khana peena mil hi jayega aur sayedar jagah bhi. Hum ne kaha bahut achha. Pas aap humein le kar Abu Al-Haitham Ansari (R.A) ke bagh ke darwaze par aaye. Aap ne salam kiya aur ijazat chahi. Umm-e-Haitham Ansariyah darwaze ke peeche hi khadi thin sun rahi thin lekin unchi awaz se jawab nahin diya aur is lalach se ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur zyada salami ki dua karein aur kai kai martaba aap ka salam sunen. Jab teen martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) salam kar chuke aur koi jawab na mila to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wapas chale diye. Ab to Hazrat Abu Al-Haitham ki biwi sahiba daudin aur kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main aap ki awaz sun rahi thi lekin mera irada tha ke Allah kare aap kai kai martaba salam karein is liye main ne apni awaz aap ko na sunayi. Aap aaiye tashreef le chaliye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un ke is fe'l ko achi nazron se dekha phir poocha ke khud Abu Al-Haitham kahan hain? Mai sahiba ne farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) woh bhi yahin qareeb hi pani lene gaye hain, aap tashreef laiye Insha'Allah aate hi honge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bagh mein ronaq afroz hue itne mein hi Hazrat Abu Al-Haitham bhi aa gaye, be-had khush hue, ankhon ko thandak aur dil ko sukoon naseeb hua aur jaldi jaldi ek khajoor ke darakht par chadh gaye aur achhe achhe khushe utar utar kar dene lage yahan tak ke khud aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne rok diya. Sahabi ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) gadli aur tar aur bilkul paki aur jis tarah ki chahein tanawal farmayein. Jab khajoorein kha chuke to meetha pani laye jise piya, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmane lage yahi woh nematein hain jin ke bare mein Allah ke han pooche jaoge. Ibn-e-Jareer ki isi hadith mein hai ke Abu Bakr, Umar baithe hue thay ke un ke pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye aur poocha ke yahan kaise baithe ho? Donon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhook ke mare ghar se nikal khade hue hain. Farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ne mujhe haq ke sath bheja hai main bhi isi wajah se is waqt nikla hoon. Ab aap unhein le kar chale aur ek Ansari ke ghar aaye, un ki biwi sahiba mil gayin. Poocha ke tumhare miyan kahan gaye hain? Kaha ghar ke liye meetha pani lane gaye hain. Itne mein to woh mashk uthaye hue aa hi gaye, khush ho gaye aur kehne lage mujh jaisa khush qismat aaj koi bhi nahin jis ke ghar Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye hain. Mashk to latka di aur khud ja kar khajooron ke taza taza khushe le aaye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya chun kar alag kar ke late to jawab diya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne chaha ke aap apni tabiyat ke mutabiq apni pasand se chun lein aur nosh farmayein. Phir chhuri hath mein uthayi ke koi janwar zibah kar ke gosht pakayein to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya dekho doodh dene wale janwar zibah na karna. Chunancha us ne zabihah kiya, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne wahin khana khaya phir farmane lage dekho bhooke ghar se nikle aur pet bhare ja rahe hain, yahi woh nematein hain jin ke bare mein Qayamat ke din sawal hoga. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke azad ghulam Hazrat Abu Aseeb ka bayan hai ke raat ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe awaz di, main nikla phir Huzoor Abu Bakr ko bulaya phir Hazrat Umar ko bulaya phir kisi Ansari ke bagh mein gaye aur us se farmaya lao bhai khane ko do. Woh angoor ke khushe utha laye aur aap ke samne rakh diye. Aap ne aur aap ke sathiyon ne khaye phir farmaya thanda pani pilwao, woh laye aap ne piya phir farmane lage Qayamat ke din is se bazpurs hogi. Hazrat Umar ne woh khusha utha kar zameen par de mara aur kehne lage is ke bare mein bhi Allah ke han pursish hogi.

Aap ne farmaya haan sirf teen cheezon ko to pursish nahin. Parda poshi ke laiq kapra, bhook rokne ke qabil tukra aur sardi garmi mein sar chupane ke liye makan (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke jab yeh Surah nazil hui aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne parh kar sunayi to Sahaba kehne lage hum se kis nemat par sawal hoga? Khajoorein kha rahe hain aur pani pee rahe hain, talwarein gardanon mein latak rahi hain aur dushman sar par khara hai. Aap ne farmaya ghabrao nahin anqareeb nematein aa jayengi. Hazrat Umar (R.A) farmate hain ke ek martaba hum baithe hue thay jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye aur nahaye hue maloom hote thay. Hum ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is waqt to aap khush-o-khurram nazar aate hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan, phir log tungari ka zikr karne lage to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis ke dil mein Allah ka khauf ho us ke liye tungari koi buri cheez nahin aur yaad rakho muttaqi shakhs ke liye sehat tungari se bhi achi hai aur khush nafsi bhi Allah ki nemat hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Tirmidhi Sharif mein hai nematon ke sawal mein Qayamat wale din sab se pehle yeh kaha jayega ke hum ne tujhe sehat nahin di thi aur thande pani se tujhe aasuda nahin kiya karte thay? Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki riwayat mein hai ke is aayat "Summa latus'alunna" (102:8) ko suna kar Sahaba kehne lage ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum to jau ki roti aur woh bhi aadha pait kha rahe hain, to Allah ki taraf se wahi aayi ke kya tum pair bachane ke liye jootiyan nahin pehente aur kya tum thande pani nahin peete? Yehi qabil-e-pursish nematein hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aman aur sehat ke bare mein sawal hoga, pait bhar khane, thande pani, saye-dar gharon, meethi neend ke bare mein bhi sawal hoga. Shehad peene, lazzatein hasil karne, subh-o-sham ke khane, ghee, shehad aur maide ki roti waghera, garz in tamam nematon ke bare mein Allah ke haan sawal hoga. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is ki tafsir mein farmate hain ke badan ki sehat, kanon aur aankhon ki sehat ke bare mein bhi sawal hoga ke in taqaton se kya kya kaam kiye, jaise Quran-e-Karim mein hai "Innas-sam'a wal-basara wal-fu'ada kullu ula'ika kana anhu mas'ula" (17:36). Har shakhs se us ke kaan, us ki aankh aur us ke dil ke bare mein bhi pooch hogi. Log bohat hi ghaflat barat rahe hain sehat aur faraghat yani na to in ka poora shukr ada karte hain aur na in ki azmat ko jante hain, na inhe Allah ki marzi ke mutabiq sarf karte hain. Bazzar mein hai tehband ke siwa, saye-dar deewaron ke siwa aur roti ke tukre ke sawal har cheez ka Qayamat ke din hisab dena parega. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki marfoo hadith mein hai ke Allah Azza-wa-Jall Qayamat ke din kahega, "Aye Ibn-e-Adam! Main ne tujhe ghoron par aur oonton par sawar karaya, auratein tere nikah mein dein, tujhe mohlat di ke tu hansi khushi aaram-o-rahat se zindagi guzare, ab bata ke is ka shukriya kahan hai?" Allah ke fazl-o-karam se Surah Takasur ki tafsir khatam hui. Falhamdulillah.

Ibn-e-Jareer ki isi hadith mein hai ke Abu Bakr, Umar baithe hue thay ke un ke pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye aur poocha ke yahan kaise baithe ho? Donon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhook ke mare ghar se nikal khade hue hain. Farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ne mujhe haq ke sath bheja hai main bhi isi wajah se is waqt nikla hoon. Ab aap unhein le kar chale aur ek Ansari ke ghar aaye, un ki biwi sahiba mil gayin. Itne mein to woh mashk uthaye hue aa hi gaye, khush ho gaye aur kehne lage mujh jaisa khush qismat aaj koi bhi nahin jis ke ghar Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye hain. Mashk to latka di aur khud ja kar khajooron ke taza taza khushe le aaye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya chun kar alag kar ke late to jawab diya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne chaha ke aap apni tabiyat ke mutabiq apni pasand se chun lein aur nosh farmayein. Phir chhuri hath mein uthayi ke koi janwar zibah kar ke gosht pakayein to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya dekho doodh dene wale janwar zibah na karna. Chunancha us ne zabihah kiya, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne wahin khana khaya phir farmane lage dekho bhooke ghar se nikle aur pet bhare ja rahe hain, yahi woh nematein hain jin ke bare mein Qayamat ke din sawal hoga. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke azad ghulam Hazrat Abu Aseeb ka bayan hai ke raat ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe awaz di, main nikla phir Huzoor Abu Bakr ko bulaya phir Hazrat Umar ko bulaya phir kisi Ansari ke bagh mein gaye aur us se farmaya lao bhai khane ko do. Woh angoor ke khushe utha laye aur aap ke samne rakh diye. Aap ne aur aap ke sathiyon ne khaye phir farmaya thanda pani pilwao, woh laye aap ne piya phir farmane lage Qayamat ke din is se bazpurs hogi. Aap ne farmaya haan sirf teen cheezon ko to pursish nahin. Parda poshi ke laiq kapra, bhook rokne ke qabil tukra aur sardi garmi mein sar chupane ke liye makan (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke jab yeh Surah nazil hui aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne parh kar sunayi to Sahaba kehne lage hum se kis nemat par sawal hoga? Khajoorein kha rahe hain aur pani pee rahe hain, talwarein gardanon mein latak rahi hain aur dushman sar par khara hai. Aap ne farmaya ghabrao nahin anqareeb nematein aa jayengi. Hazrat Umar (R.A) farmate hain ke ek martaba hum baithe hue thay jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye aur nahaye hue maloom hote thay. Hum ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is waqt to aap khush-o-khurram nazar aate hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan, phir log tungari ka zikr karne lage to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis ke dil mein Allah ka khauf ho us ke liye tungari koi buri cheez nahin aur yaad rakho muttaqi shakhs ke liye sehat tungari se bhi achi hai aur khush nafsi bhi Allah ki nemat hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Tirmidhi Sharif mein hai nematon ke sawal mein Qayamat wale din sab se pehle yeh kaha jayega ke hum ne tujhe sehat nahin di thi aur thande pani se tujhe aasuda nahin kiya karte thay? Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki riwayat mein hai ke is aayat "Summa latus'alunna" (102:8) ko suna kar Sahaba kehne lage ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum to jau ki roti aur woh bhi aadha pait kha rahe hain, to Allah ki taraf se wahi aayi ke kya tum pair bachane ke liye jootiyan nahin pehente aur kya tum thande pani nahin peete? Yehi qabil-e-pursish nematein hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aman aur sehat ke bare mein sawal hoga, pait bhar khane, thande pani, saye-dar gharon, meethi neend ke bare mein bhi sawal hoga. Shehad peene, lazzatein hasil karne, subh-o-sham ke khane, ghee, shehad aur maide ki roti waghera, garz in tamam nematon ke bare mein Allah ke haan sawal hoga. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is ki tafsir mein farmate hain ke badan ki sehat, kanon aur aankhon ki sehat ke bare mein bhi sawal hoga ke in taqaton se kya kya kaam kiye, jaise Quran-e-Karim mein hai "Innas-sam'a wal-basara wal-fu'ada kullu ula'ika kana anhu mas'ula" (17:36). Har shakhs se us ke kaan, us ki aankh aur us ke dil ke bare mein bhi pooch hogi. Log bohat hi ghaflat barat rahe hain sehat aur faraghat yani na to in ka poora shukr ada karte hain aur na in ki azmat ko jante hain, na inhe Allah ki marzi ke mutabiq sarf karte hain. Bazzar mein hai tehband ke siwa, saye-dar deewaron ke siwa aur roti ke tukre ke sawal har cheez ka Qayamat ke din hisab dena parega. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki marfoo hadith mein hai ke Allah Azza-wa-Jall Qayamat ke din kahega, "Aye Ibn-e-Adam! Main ne tujhe ghoron par aur oonton par sawar karaya, auratein tere nikah mein dein, tujhe mohlat di ke tu hansi khushi aaram-o-rahat se zindagi guzare, ab bata ke is ka shukriya kahan hai?" Allah ke fazl-o-karam se Surah Takasur ki tafsir khatam hui. Falhamdulillah.

Tum isi duniya ki udher-bun mein rahe ke achanak maut aa gayi aur tum qabron mein pahunch gaye. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain, ita'at-e-Parwardigar se tum ne duniya ki justuju mein phans kar be-raghbati kar li aur marte dam tak ghaflat barti (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain, maal aur aulad ki ziyadati ki hawas mein maut ka khayal pare phenk diya. Sahih Bukhari Kitab-ur-Riqaq mein hai ke Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain, hum "Law kana li-ibni Adama wadiyan min dhahab" yani agar Ibn-e-Adam ke paas ek jangal bhar kar sona ho, ise Quran ki aayat hi samajhte rahe yahan tak ke "Alhakumut-Takathur" nazil hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Shikh-kheer (R.A) farmate hain, main janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein jab aaya to aap is aayat ko parh rahe the. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, Ibn-e-Adam kehta rehta hai ke mera maal, mera maal, halankeh tera maal sirf woh hai jise tu ne kha kar fana kar diya, ya pehan kar phaar diya, ya sadqa de kar baqi rakh liya. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein itna aur ziyada hai ke iske siwa jo kuch hai, ise to tu logon ke liye chor-chaar kar chal dega. Bukhari ki hadith mein hai, mayyat ke saath teen cheezein jaati hain, jin mein se do to palat aati hain, sirf ek saath reh jaati hai; ghar wale, maal aur a'maal. Ahl-o-maal laut aaye, amal saath reh gaye. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai, Ibn-e-Adam boorha ho jaata hai lekin do cheezein uske saath baqi reh jaati hain; lalach aur umang. Hazrat Sahhak ne ek shakhs ke haath mein ek dirham dekh kar poocha, yeh dirham kis ka hai? Usne kaha mera. Farmaya, tera to us waqt hoga ke kisi nek kaam mein tu kharch kar de ya bator-e-shukr-e-Rabb ke kharch kare. Woh unhein apne murdon ke saath ilzam dene lage. Bukhari ki hadith mein hai, mayyat ke saath teen cheezein jaati hain, jin mein se do to palat aati hain, sirf ek saath reh jaati hai; ghar wale, maal aur a'maal. Ahl-o-maal laut aaye, amal saath reh gaye. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai, Ibn-e-Adam boorha ho jaata hai lekin do cheezein uske saath baqi reh jaati hain; lalach aur umang. Hazrat Sahhak ne ek shakhs ke haath mein ek dirham dekh kar poocha, yeh dirham kis ka hai? Usne kaha mera. Farmaya, tera to us waqt hoga ke kisi nek kaam mein tu kharch kar de ya bator-e-shukr-e-Rabb ke kharch kare. Hazrat Ahnaf ne is waqiye ko bayan kar ke phir yeh sher parha: "Anta lil-maali iza amsaktahu, fa-iza anfaqtahu fal-maalu laka" yani jab tak tu maal ko liye baitha hai, to tu maal ki milkiyat hai, haan jab ise kharch kar dega us waqt maal teri milkiyat mein ho jayega. Ibn-e-Buraidah farmate hain, Banu Haritha aur Banu Harith Ansar ke qabile wale apne mein se aison ko pesh karte the. Jab zindon ke saath yeh fakhr-o-mubahat kar chuke to kehne lage, aao qabristan mein chalein, wahan ja kar apne apne murdon ki qabron ki taraf ishare kar ke kehne lage, batao is jaisa bhi tum mein koi guzra hai? Woh unhein apne murdon ke saath ilzam dene lage. Is par yeh dono ibtidai aayatein utrin ke tum fakhr-o-mubahat karte hue qabristan mein pahunch gaye aur apne apne murdon par bhi fakhr-o-ghuroor karne lage. Chahiye tha ke yahan aa kar ibrat hasil karte, apna marna aur sarna-galna yaad karte.

Hazrat Qatada Rahimahullah farmate hain ke log apni ziyadati aur apni kasrat par ghamand karte thay yahan tak ke ek ek ho kar qabron mein pahunch gaye. Matlab yeh hai ke bohtat ki chahat ne ghaflat mein hi rakha yahan tak ke mar gaye aur qabron mein dafan ho gaye. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek a'arabi ki bimar pursi ko gaye aur hasb-e-adat farmaya koi dar khauf nahin, Insha'Allah gunahon se pakeezgi hasil hogi. To usne kaha aap ise khoob paka batla rahe hain, yeh to woh bukhar hai jo boodhe badon par josh marta hai aur qabr tak pahuncha kar rehta hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya achha phir yun hi sahi. Is hadith mein bhi lafz 'tazoorul quboor' hai aur yahan Quran mein bhi 'zurtumul maqabir' hai. Pas maloom hota hai ke is se murad mar kar qabr mein dafan hona hi hai. Tirmidhi mein hai Hazrat Ali Karamallahu Wajhahu farmate hain ke jab tak yeh ayat na utri hum azab-e-qabr ke bare mein shak mein hi rahe. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz ne is ayat ki tilawat ki phir kuch der soch kar farmane lage, Maimoon! Qabron ka dekhna to sirf bator-e-ziyarat hai aur har ziyarat karne wala apni jagah laut jata hai, yani khwah jannat ki taraf khwah dozakh ki taraf. Ek a'arabi ne bhi ek shakhs ki zabani in dono ayaton ki tilawat sun kar yahi farmaya tha ke asal maqam aur hi hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala dhamkate hue do do martaba farmata hai ke haqiqat-e-hal ka ilm tumhein abhi ho jayega. Yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke pehle murad kuffar hain, dobara momin murad hain. Phir farmata hai ke agar tum ilm-e-yaqini ke sath ise maloom kar lete, yani agar aisa hota to tum ghaflat mein na padte aur marte dam tak apni akhri manzil-e-akhirat se ghafil na rehte. Phir jis cheez se pehle dhamkaya tha usi ka bayan kar raha hai ke tum jahannam ko inhi ankhon se dekh loge ke uski ek hi junbish ke sath aur to aur Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) bhi haibat-o-khauf ke mare ghutnon ke bal gir jayenge. Uski azmat aur dehshat har dil par chhayi hui hogi jaise ke bahut si ahadith mein ba-tafseel marwi hai. Phir farmaya ke us din tum se nematon ki bazpurs hogi, sehat, amn, rizq wagaira tamam nematon ki nisbat sawal hoga ke in ka shukr kahan tak ada kiya. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek ghareeb hadith mein hai ke theek dopahar ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne ghar se chale dekha to Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) bhi masjid mein aa rahe hain. Poocha ke is waqt kaise nikle ho? Kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jis cheez ne aap ko nikala hai usi ne mujhe bhi nikala hai. Itne mein Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) bhi aa gaye, un se bhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yahi sawal kiya aur aap ne bhi yahi jawab diya. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne in dono buzurgon se baten karni shuru keen phir farmaya ke agar himmat ho to is bagh tak chale chalo, khana peena mil hi jayega aur sayedar jagah bhi. Hum ne kaha bahut achha. Pas aap humein le kar Abu Al-Haitham Ansari (R.A) ke bagh ke darwaze par aaye. Aap ne salam kiya aur ijazat chahi. Umm-e-Haitham Ansariyah darwaze ke peeche hi khadi thin sun rahi thin lekin unchi awaz se jawab nahin diya aur is lalach se ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur zyada salami ki dua karein aur kai kai martaba aap ka salam sunen. Jab teen martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) salam kar chuke aur koi jawab na mila to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wapas chale diye. Ab to Hazrat Abu Al-Haitham ki biwi sahiba daudin aur kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main aap ki awaz sun rahi thi lekin mera irada tha ke Allah kare aap kai kai martaba salam karein is liye main ne apni awaz aap ko na sunayi. Aap aaiye tashreef le chaliye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un ke is fe'l ko achi nazron se dekha phir poocha ke khud Abu Al-Haitham kahan hain? Mai sahiba ne farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) woh bhi yahin qareeb hi pani lene gaye hain, aap tashreef laiye Insha'Allah aate hi honge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bagh mein ronaq afroz hue itne mein hi Hazrat Abu Al-Haitham bhi aa gaye, be-had khush hue, ankhon ko thandak aur dil ko sukoon naseeb hua aur jaldi jaldi ek khajoor ke darakht par chadh gaye aur achhe achhe khushe utar utar kar dene lage yahan tak ke khud aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne rok diya. Sahabi ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) gadli aur tar aur bilkul paki aur jis tarah ki chahein tanawal farmayein. Jab khajoorein kha chuke to meetha pani laye jise piya, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmane lage yahi woh nematein hain jin ke bare mein Allah ke han pooche jaoge. Ibn-e-Jareer ki isi hadith mein hai ke Abu Bakr, Umar baithe hue thay ke un ke pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye aur poocha ke yahan kaise baithe ho? Donon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhook ke mare ghar se nikal khade hue hain. Farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ne mujhe haq ke sath bheja hai main bhi isi wajah se is waqt nikla hoon. Ab aap unhein le kar chale aur ek Ansari ke ghar aaye, un ki biwi sahiba mil gayin. Poocha ke tumhare miyan kahan gaye hain? Kaha ghar ke liye meetha pani lane gaye hain. Itne mein to woh mashk uthaye hue aa hi gaye, khush ho gaye aur kehne lage mujh jaisa khush qismat aaj koi bhi nahin jis ke ghar Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye hain. Mashk to latka di aur khud ja kar khajooron ke taza taza khushe le aaye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya chun kar alag kar ke late to jawab diya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne chaha ke aap apni tabiyat ke mutabiq apni pasand se chun lein aur nosh farmayein. Phir chhuri hath mein uthayi ke koi janwar zibah kar ke gosht pakayein to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya dekho doodh dene wale janwar zibah na karna. Chunancha us ne zabihah kiya, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne wahin khana khaya phir farmane lage dekho bhooke ghar se nikle aur pet bhare ja rahe hain, yahi woh nematein hain jin ke bare mein Qayamat ke din sawal hoga. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke azad ghulam Hazrat Abu Aseeb ka bayan hai ke raat ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe awaz di, main nikla phir Huzoor Abu Bakr ko bulaya phir Hazrat Umar ko bulaya phir kisi Ansari ke bagh mein gaye aur us se farmaya lao bhai khane ko do. Woh angoor ke khushe utha laye aur aap ke samne rakh diye. Aap ne aur aap ke sathiyon ne khaye phir farmaya thanda pani pilwao, woh laye aap ne piya phir farmane lage Qayamat ke din is se bazpurs hogi. Hazrat Umar ne woh khusha utha kar zameen par de mara aur kehne lage is ke bare mein bhi Allah ke han pursish hogi.

Aap ne farmaya haan sirf teen cheezon ko to pursish nahin. Parda poshi ke laiq kapra, bhook rokne ke qabil tukra aur sardi garmi mein sar chupane ke liye makan (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke jab yeh Surah nazil hui aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne parh kar sunayi to Sahaba kehne lage hum se kis nemat par sawal hoga? Khajoorein kha rahe hain aur pani pee rahe hain, talwarein gardanon mein latak rahi hain aur dushman sar par khara hai. Aap ne farmaya ghabrao nahin anqareeb nematein aa jayengi. Hazrat Umar (R.A) farmate hain ke ek martaba hum baithe hue thay jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye aur nahaye hue maloom hote thay. Hum ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is waqt to aap khush-o-khurram nazar aate hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan, phir log tungari ka zikr karne lage to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis ke dil mein Allah ka khauf ho us ke liye tungari koi buri cheez nahin aur yaad rakho muttaqi shakhs ke liye sehat tungari se bhi achi hai aur khush nafsi bhi Allah ki nemat hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Tirmidhi Sharif mein hai nematon ke sawal mein Qayamat wale din sab se pehle yeh kaha jayega ke hum ne tujhe sehat nahin di thi aur thande pani se tujhe aasuda nahin kiya karte thay? Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki riwayat mein hai ke is aayat "Summa latus'alunna" (102:8) ko suna kar Sahaba kehne lage ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum to jau ki roti aur woh bhi aadha pait kha rahe hain, to Allah ki taraf se wahi aayi ke kya tum pair bachane ke liye jootiyan nahin pehente aur kya tum thande pani nahin peete? Yehi qabil-e-pursish nematein hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aman aur sehat ke bare mein sawal hoga, pait bhar khane, thande pani, saye-dar gharon, meethi neend ke bare mein bhi sawal hoga. Shehad peene, lazzatein hasil karne, subh-o-sham ke khane, ghee, shehad aur maide ki roti waghera, garz in tamam nematon ke bare mein Allah ke haan sawal hoga. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is ki tafsir mein farmate hain ke badan ki sehat, kanon aur aankhon ki sehat ke bare mein bhi sawal hoga ke in taqaton se kya kya kaam kiye, jaise Quran-e-Karim mein hai "Innas-sam'a wal-basara wal-fu'ada kullu ula'ika kana anhu mas'ula" (17:36). Har shakhs se us ke kaan, us ki aankh aur us ke dil ke bare mein bhi pooch hogi. Log bohat hi ghaflat barat rahe hain sehat aur faraghat yani na to in ka poora shukr ada karte hain aur na in ki azmat ko jante hain, na inhe Allah ki marzi ke mutabiq sarf karte hain. Bazzar mein hai tehband ke siwa, saye-dar deewaron ke siwa aur roti ke tukre ke sawal har cheez ka Qayamat ke din hisab dena parega. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki marfoo hadith mein hai ke Allah Azza-wa-Jall Qayamat ke din kahega, "Aye Ibn-e-Adam! Main ne tujhe ghoron par aur oonton par sawar karaya, auratein tere nikah mein dein, tujhe mohlat di ke tu hansi khushi aaram-o-rahat se zindagi guzare, ab bata ke is ka shukriya kahan hai?" Allah ke fazl-o-karam se Surah Takasur ki tafsir khatam hui. Falhamdulillah.

Itne mein to woh mashk uthaye hue aa hi gaye, khush ho gaye aur kehne lage mujh jaisa khush qismat aaj koi bhi nahin jis ke ghar Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye hain. Mashk to latka di aur khud ja kar khajooron ke taza taza khushe le aaye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya chun kar alag kar ke late to jawab diya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne chaha ke aap apni tabiyat ke mutabiq apni pasand se chun lein aur nosh farmayein. Phir chhuri hath mein uthayi ke koi janwar zibah kar ke gosht pakayein to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya dekho doodh dene wale janwar zibah na karna. Chunancha us ne zabihah kiya, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne wahin khana khaya phir farmane lage dekho bhooke ghar se nikle aur pet bhare ja rahe hain, yahi woh nematein hain jin ke bare mein Qayamat ke din sawal hoga. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke azad ghulam Hazrat Abu Aseeb ka bayan hai ke raat ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe awaz di, main nikla phir Huzoor Abu Bakr ko bulaya phir Hazrat Umar ko bulaya phir kisi Ansari ke bagh mein gaye aur us se farmaya lao bhai khane ko do. Woh angoor ke khushe utha laye aur aap ke samne rakh diye. Aap ne aur aap ke sathiyon ne khaye phir farmaya thanda pani pilwao, woh laye aap ne piya phir farmane lage Qayamat ke din is se bazpurs hogi. Hazrat Umar ne woh khusha utha kar zameen par de mara aur kehne lage is ke bare mein bhi Allah ke han pursish hogi.

Aap ne farmaya haan sirf teen cheezon ko to pursish nahin. Parda poshi ke laiq kapra, bhook rokne ke qabil tukra aur sardi garmi mein sar chupane ke liye makan (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke jab yeh Surah nazil hui aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne parh kar sunayi to Sahaba kehne lage hum se kis nemat par sawal hoga? Khajoorein kha rahe hain aur pani pee rahe hain, talwarein gardanon mein latak rahi hain aur dushman sar par khara hai. Aap ne farmaya ghabrao nahin anqareeb nematein aa jayengi. Hazrat Umar (R.A) farmate hain ke ek martaba hum baithe hue thay jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye aur nahaye hue maloom hote thay. Hum ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is waqt to aap khush-o-khurram nazar aate hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan, phir log tungari ka zikr karne lage to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis ke dil mein Allah ka khauf ho us ke liye tungari koi buri cheez nahin aur yaad rakho muttaqi shakhs ke liye sehat tungari se bhi achi hai aur khush nafsi bhi Allah ki nemat hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Tirmidhi Sharif mein hai nematon ke sawal mein Qayamat wale din sab se pehle yeh kaha jayega ke hum ne tujhe sehat nahin di thi aur thande pani se tujhe aasuda nahin kiya karte thay? Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki riwayat mein hai ke is aayat "Summa latus'alunna" (102:8) ko suna kar Sahaba kehne lage ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum to jau ki roti aur woh bhi aadha pait kha rahe hain, to Allah ki taraf se wahi aayi ke kya tum pair bachane ke liye jootiyan nahin pehente aur kya tum thande pani nahin peete? Yehi qabil-e-pursish nematein hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aman aur sehat ke bare mein sawal hoga, pait bhar khane, thande pani, saye-dar gharon, meethi neend ke bare mein bhi sawal hoga. Shehad peene, lazzatein hasil karne, subh-o-sham ke khane, ghee, shehad aur maide ki roti waghera, garz in tamam nematon ke bare mein Allah ke haan sawal hoga. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is ki tafsir mein farmate hain ke badan ki sehat, kanon aur aankhon ki sehat ke bare mein bhi sawal hoga ke in taqaton se kya kya kaam kiye, jaise Quran-e-Karim mein hai "Innas-sam'a wal-basara wal-fu'ada kullu ula'ika kana anhu mas'ula" (17:36). Har shakhs se us ke kaan, us ki aankh aur us ke dil ke bare mein bhi pooch hogi. Log bohat hi ghaflat barat rahe hain sehat aur faraghat yani na to in ka poora shukr ada karte hain aur na in ki azmat ko jante hain, na inhe Allah ki marzi ke mutabiq sarf karte hain. Bazzar mein hai tehband ke siwa, saye-dar deewaron ke siwa aur roti ke tukre ke sawal har cheez ka Qayamat ke din hisab dena parega. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki marfoo hadith mein hai ke Allah Azza-wa-Jall Qayamat ke din kahega, "Aye Ibn-e-Adam! Main ne tujhe ghoron par aur oonton par sawar karaya, auratein tere nikah mein dein, tujhe mohlat di ke tu hansi khushi aaram-o-rahat se zindagi guzare, ab bata ke is ka shukriya kahan hai?" Allah ke fazl-o-karam se Surah Takasur ki tafsir khatam hui. Falhamdulillah.

Tum isi duniya ki udher-bun mein rahe ke achanak maut aa gayi aur tum qabron mein pahunch gaye. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain, ita'at-e-Parwardigar se tum ne duniya ki justuju mein phans kar be-raghbati kar li aur marte dam tak ghaflat barti (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain, maal aur aulad ki ziyadati ki hawas mein maut ka khayal pare phenk diya. Sahih Bukhari Kitab-ur-Riqaq mein hai ke Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain, hum "Law kana li-ibni Adama wadiyan min dhahab" yani agar Ibn-e-Adam ke paas ek jangal bhar kar sona ho, ise Quran ki aayat hi samajhte rahe yahan tak ke "Alhakumut-Takathur" nazil hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Shikh-kheer (R.A) farmate hain, main janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein jab aaya to aap is aayat ko parh rahe the. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, Ibn-e-Adam kehta rehta hai ke mera maal, mera maal, halankeh tera maal sirf woh hai jise tu ne kha kar fana kar diya, ya pehan kar phaar diya, ya sadqa de kar baqi rakh liya. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein itna aur ziyada hai ke iske siwa jo kuch hai, ise to tu logon ke liye chor-chaar kar chal dega. Bukhari ki hadith mein hai, mayyat ke saath teen cheezein jaati hain, jin mein se do to palat aati hain, sirf ek saath reh jaati hai; ghar wale, maal aur a'maal. Ahl-o-maal laut aaye, amal saath reh gaye. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai, Ibn-e-Adam boorha ho jaata hai lekin do cheezein uske saath baqi reh jaati hain; lalach aur umang. Hazrat Sahhak ne ek shakhs ke haath mein ek dirham dekh kar poocha, yeh dirham kis ka hai? Usne kaha mera. Farmaya, tera to us waqt hoga ke kisi nek kaam mein tu kharch kar de ya bator-e-shukr-e-Rabb ke kharch kare. Hazrat Ahnaf ne is waqiye ko bayan kar ke phir yeh sher parha: "Anta lil-maali iza amsaktahu, fa-iza anfaqtahu fal-maalu laka" yani jab tak tu maal ko liye baitha hai, to tu maal ki milkiyat hai, haan jab ise kharch kar dega us waqt maal teri milkiyat mein ho jayega. Ibn-e-Buraidah farmate hain, Banu Haritha aur Banu Harith Ansar ke qabile wale apne mein se aison ko pesh karte the. Woh unhein apne murdon ke saath ilzam dene lage. Is par yeh dono ibtidai aayatein utrin ke tum fakhr-o-mubahat karte hue qabristan mein pahunch gaye aur apne apne murdon par bhi fakhr-o-ghuroor karne lage. Chahiye tha ke yahan aa kar ibrat hasil karte, apna marna aur sarna-galna yaad karte.

Jab zindon ke saath yeh fakhr-o-mubahat kar chuke to kehne lage, aao qabristan mein chalein, wahan ja kar apne apne murdon ki qabron ki taraf ishare kar ke kehne lage, batao is jaisa bhi tum mein koi guzra hai? Woh unhein apne murdon ke saath ilzam dene lage. Is par yeh dono ibtidai aayatein utrin ke tum fakhr-o-mubahat karte hue qabristan mein pahunch gaye aur apne apne murdon par bhi fakhr-o-ghuroor karne lage. Chahiye tha ke yahan aa kar ibrat hasil karte, apna marna aur sarna-galna yaad karte.

Hazrat Qatada Rahimahullah farmate hain ke log apni ziyadati aur apni kasrat par ghamand karte thay yahan tak ke ek ek ho kar qabron mein pahunch gaye. Matlab yeh hai ke bohtat ki chahat ne ghaflat mein hi rakha yahan tak ke mar gaye aur qabron mein dafan ho gaye. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek a'arabi ki bimar pursi ko gaye aur hasb-e-adat farmaya koi dar khauf nahin, Insha'Allah gunahon se pakeezgi hasil hogi. To usne kaha aap ise khoob paka batla rahe hain, yeh to woh bukhar hai jo boodhe badon par josh marta hai aur qabr tak pahuncha kar rehta hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya achha phir yun hi sahi. Is hadith mein bhi lafz 'tazoorul quboor' hai aur yahan Quran mein bhi 'zurtumul maqabir' hai. Pas maloom hota hai ke is se murad mar kar qabr mein dafan hona hi hai. Tirmidhi mein hai Hazrat Ali Karamallahu Wajhahu farmate hain ke jab tak yeh ayat na utri hum azab-e-qabr ke bare mein shak mein hi rahe. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz ne is ayat ki tilawat ki phir kuch der soch kar farmane lage, Maimoon! Qabron ka dekhna to sirf bator-e-ziyarat hai aur har ziyarat karne wala apni jagah laut jata hai, yani khwah jannat ki taraf khwah dozakh ki taraf. Ek a'arabi ne bhi ek shakhs ki zabani in dono ayaton ki tilawat sun kar yahi farmaya tha ke asal maqam aur hi hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala dhamkate hue do do martaba farmata hai ke haqiqat-e-hal ka ilm tumhein abhi ho jayega. Yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke pehle murad kuffar hain, dobara momin murad hain. Phir farmata hai ke agar tum ilm-e-yaqini ke sath ise maloom kar lete, yani agar aisa hota to tum ghaflat mein na padte aur marte dam tak apni akhri manzil-e-akhirat se ghafil na rehte. Phir jis cheez se pehle dhamkaya tha usi ka bayan kar raha hai ke tum jahannam ko inhi ankhon se dekh loge ke uski ek hi junbish ke sath aur to aur Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) bhi haibat-o-khauf ke mare ghutnon ke bal gir jayenge. Uski azmat aur dehshat har dil par chhayi hui hogi jaise ke bahut si ahadith mein ba-tafseel marwi hai. Phir farmaya ke us din tum se nematon ki bazpurs hogi, sehat, amn, rizq wagaira tamam nematon ki nisbat sawal hoga ke in ka shukr kahan tak ada kiya. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek ghareeb hadith mein hai ke theek dopahar ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apne ghar se chale dekha to Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) bhi masjid mein aa rahe hain. Poocha ke is waqt kaise nikle ho? Kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jis cheez ne aap ko nikala hai usi ne mujhe bhi nikala hai. Itne mein Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) bhi aa gaye, un se bhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yahi sawal kiya aur aap ne bhi yahi jawab diya. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne in dono buzurgon se baten karni shuru keen phir farmaya ke agar himmat ho to is bagh tak chale chalo, khana peena mil hi jayega aur sayedar jagah bhi. Hum ne kaha bahut achha. Pas aap humein le kar Abu Al-Haitham Ansari (R.A) ke bagh ke darwaze par aaye. Aap ne salam kiya aur ijazat chahi. Umm-e-Haitham Ansariyah darwaze ke peeche hi khadi thin sun rahi thin lekin unchi awaz se jawab nahin diya aur is lalach se ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur zyada salami ki dua karein aur kai kai martaba aap ka salam sunen. Jab teen martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) salam kar chuke aur koi jawab na mila to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wapas chale diye. Ab to Hazrat Abu Al-Haitham ki biwi sahiba daudin aur kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main aap ki awaz sun rahi thi lekin mera irada tha ke Allah kare aap kai kai martaba salam karein is liye main ne apni awaz aap ko na sunayi. Aap aaiye tashreef le chaliye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un ke is fe'l ko achi nazron se dekha phir poocha ke khud Abu Al-Haitham kahan hain? Mai sahiba ne farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) woh bhi yahin qareeb hi pani lene gaye hain, aap tashreef laiye Insha'Allah aate hi honge. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bagh mein ronaq afroz hue itne mein hi Hazrat Abu Al-Haitham bhi aa gaye, be-had khush hue, ankhon ko thandak aur dil ko sukoon naseeb hua aur jaldi jaldi ek khajoor ke darakht par chadh gaye aur achhe achhe khushe utar utar kar dene lage yahan tak ke khud aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne rok diya. Sahabi ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) gadli aur tar aur bilkul paki aur jis tarah ki chahein tanawal farmayein. Jab khajoorein kha chuke to meetha pani laye jise piya, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmane lage yahi woh nematein hain jin ke bare mein Allah ke han pooche jaoge. Ibn-e-Jareer ki isi hadith mein hai ke Abu Bakr, Umar baithe hue thay ke un ke pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye aur poocha ke yahan kaise baithe ho? Donon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhook ke mare ghar se nikal khade hue hain. Farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ne mujhe haq ke sath bheja hai main bhi isi wajah se is waqt nikla hoon. Ab aap unhein le kar chale aur ek Ansari ke ghar aaye, un ki biwi sahiba mil gayin. Poocha ke tumhare miyan kahan gaye hain? Kaha ghar ke liye meetha pani lane gaye hain. Itne mein to woh mashk uthaye hue aa hi gaye, khush ho gaye aur kehne lage mujh jaisa khush qismat aaj koi bhi nahin jis ke ghar Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye hain. Mashk to latka di aur khud ja kar khajooron ke taza taza khushe le aaye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya chun kar alag kar ke late to jawab diya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main ne chaha ke aap apni tabiyat ke mutabiq apni pasand se chun lein aur nosh farmayein. Phir chhuri hath mein uthayi ke koi janwar zibah kar ke gosht pakayein to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya dekho doodh dene wale janwar zibah na karna. Chunancha us ne zabihah kiya, aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne wahin khana khaya phir farmane lage dekho bhooke ghar se nikle aur pet bhare ja rahe hain, yahi woh nematein hain jin ke bare mein Qayamat ke din sawal hoga. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke azad ghulam Hazrat Abu Aseeb ka bayan hai ke raat ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe awaz di, main nikla phir Huzoor Abu Bakr ko bulaya phir Hazrat Umar ko bulaya phir kisi Ansari ke bagh mein gaye aur us se farmaya lao bhai khane ko do. Woh angoor ke khushe utha laye aur aap ke samne rakh diye. Aap ne aur aap ke sathiyon ne khaye phir farmaya thanda pani pilwao, woh laye aap ne piya phir farmane lage Qayamat ke din is se bazpurs hogi. Hazrat Umar ne woh khusha utha kar zameen par de mara aur kehne lage is ke bare mein bhi Allah ke han pursish hogi.

Aap ne farmaya haan sirf teen cheezon ko to pursish nahin. Parda poshi ke laiq kapra, bhook rokne ke qabil tukra aur sardi garmi mein sar chupane ke liye makan (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke jab yeh Surah nazil hui aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne parh kar sunayi to Sahaba kehne lage hum se kis nemat par sawal hoga? Khajoorein kha rahe hain aur pani pee rahe hain, talwarein gardanon mein latak rahi hain aur dushman sar par khara hai. Aap ne farmaya ghabrao nahin anqareeb nematein aa jayengi. Hazrat Umar (R.A) farmate hain ke ek martaba hum baithe hue thay jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye aur nahaye hue maloom hote thay. Hum ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is waqt to aap khush-o-khurram nazar aate hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan, phir log tungari ka zikr karne lage to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis ke dil mein Allah ka khauf ho us ke liye tungari koi buri cheez nahin aur yaad rakho muttaqi shakhs ke liye sehat tungari se bhi achi hai aur khush nafsi bhi Allah ki nemat hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Tirmidhi Sharif mein hai nematon ke sawal mein Qayamat wale din sab se pehle yeh kaha jayega ke hum ne tujhe sehat nahin di thi aur thande pani se tujhe aasuda nahin kiya karte thay? Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki riwayat mein hai ke is aayat "Summa latus'alunna" (102:8) ko suna kar Sahaba kehne lage ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum to jau ki roti aur woh bhi aadha pait kha rahe hain, to Allah ki taraf se wahi aayi ke kya tum pair bachane ke liye jootiyan nahin pehente aur kya tum thande pani nahin peete? Yehi qabil-e-pursish nematein hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aman aur sehat ke bare mein sawal hoga, pait bhar khane, thande pani, saye-dar gharon, meethi neend ke bare mein bhi sawal hoga. Shehad peene, lazzatein hasil karne, subh-o-sham ke khane, ghee, shehad aur maide ki roti waghera, garz in tamam nematon ke bare mein Allah ke haan sawal hoga. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is ki tafsir mein farmate hain ke badan ki sehat, kanon aur aankhon ki sehat ke bare mein bhi sawal hoga ke in taqaton se kya kya kaam kiye, jaise Quran-e-Karim mein hai "Innas-sam'a wal-basara wal-fu'ada kullu ula'ika kana anhu mas'ula" (17:36). Har shakhs se us ke kaan, us ki aankh aur us ke dil ke bare mein bhi pooch hogi. Log bohat hi ghaflat barat rahe hain sehat aur faraghat yani na to in ka poora shukr ada karte hain aur na in ki azmat ko jante hain, na inhe Allah ki marzi ke mutabiq sarf karte hain. Bazzar mein hai tehband ke siwa, saye-dar deewaron ke siwa aur roti ke tukre ke sawal har cheez ka Qayamat ke din hisab dena parega. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki marfoo hadith mein hai ke Allah Azza-wa-Jall Qayamat ke din kahega, "Aye Ibn-e-Adam! Main ne tujhe ghoron par aur oonton par sawar karaya, auratein tere nikah mein dein, tujhe mohlat di ke tu hansi khushi aaram-o-rahat se zindagi guzare, ab bata ke is ka shukriya kahan hai?" Allah ke fazl-o-karam se Surah Takasur ki tafsir khatam hui. Falhamdulillah.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Shikh-kheer (R.A) farmate hain, main janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein jab aaya to aap is aayat ko parh rahe the. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke azad ghulam Hazrat Abu Aseeb ka bayan hai ke raat ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe awaz di, main nikla phir Huzoor Abu Bakr ko bulaya phir Hazrat Umar ko bulaya phir kisi Ansari ke bagh mein gaye aur us se farmaya lao bhai khane ko do. Woh angoor ke khushe utha laye aur aap ke samne rakh diye. Aap ne aur aap ke sathiyon ne khaye phir farmaya thanda pani pilwao, woh laye aap ne piya phir farmane lage Qayamat ke din is se bazpurs hogi. Hazrat Umar ne woh khusha utha kar zameen par de mara aur kehne lage is ke bare mein bhi Allah ke han pursish hogi.

Aap ne farmaya haan sirf teen cheezon ko to pursish nahin. Parda poshi ke laiq kapra, bhook rokne ke qabil tukra aur sardi garmi mein sar chupane ke liye makan (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke jab yeh Surah nazil hui aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne parh kar sunayi to Sahaba kehne lage hum se kis nemat par sawal hoga? Khajoorein kha rahe hain aur pani pee rahe hain, talwarein gardanon mein latak rahi hain aur dushman sar par khara hai. Aap ne farmaya ghabrao nahin anqareeb nematein aa jayengi. Hazrat Umar (R.A) farmate hain ke ek martaba hum baithe hue thay jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye aur nahaye hue maloom hote thay. Hum ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is waqt to aap khush-o-khurram nazar aate hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan, phir log tungari ka zikr karne lage to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jis ke dil mein Allah ka khauf ho us ke liye tungari koi buri cheez nahin aur yaad rakho muttaqi shakhs ke liye sehat tungari se bhi achi hai aur khush nafsi bhi Allah ki nemat hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Ibn-e-Majah mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Tirmidhi Sharif mein hai nematon ke sawal mein Qayamat wale din sab se pehle yeh kaha jayega ke hum ne tujhe sehat nahin di thi aur thande pani se tujhe aasuda nahin kiya karte thay? Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki riwayat mein hai ke is aayat "Summa latus'alunna" (102:8) ko suna kar Sahaba kehne lage ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum to jau ki roti aur woh bhi aadha pait kha rahe hain, to Allah ki taraf se wahi aayi ke kya tum pair bachane ke liye jootiyan nahin pehente aur kya tum thande pani nahin peete? Yehi qabil-e-pursish nematein hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke aman aur sehat ke bare mein sawal hoga, pait bhar khane, thande pani, saye-dar gharon, meethi neend ke bare mein bhi sawal hoga. Shehad peene, lazzatein hasil karne, subh-o-sham ke khane, ghee, shehad aur maide ki roti waghera, garz in tamam nematon ke bare mein Allah ke haan sawal hoga. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) is ki tafsir mein farmate hain ke badan ki sehat, kanon aur aankhon ki sehat ke bare mein bhi sawal hoga ke in taqaton se kya kya kaam kiye, jaise Quran-e-Karim mein hai "Innas-sam'a wal-basara wal-fu'ada kullu ula'ika kana anhu mas'ula" (17:36). Har shakhs se us ke kaan, us ki aankh aur us ke dil ke bare mein bhi pooch hogi. Log bohat hi ghaflat barat rahe hain sehat aur faraghat yani na to in ka poora shukr ada karte hain aur na in ki azmat ko jante hain, na inhe Allah ki marzi ke mutabiq sarf karte hain. Bazzar mein hai tehband ke siwa, saye-dar deewaron ke siwa aur roti ke tukre ke sawal har cheez ka Qayamat ke din hisab dena parega. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki marfoo hadith mein hai ke Allah Azza-wa-Jall Qayamat ke din kahega, "Aye Ibn-e-Adam! Main ne tujhe ghoron par aur oonton par sawar karaya, auratein tere nikah mein dein, tujhe mohlat di ke tu hansi khushi aaram-o-rahat se zindagi guzare, ab bata ke is ka shukriya kahan hai?" Allah ke fazl-o-karam se Surah Takasur ki tafsir khatam hui. Falhamdulillah.
